description: Biloliddin Makhmudov publishes a real-scale 3D model of the post-2021 Devonaboy mosque in Andijan, Uzbekistan, with measurement notes and drawings. The project README identifies a self-contained GLB exterior and prayer-hall model, a dimension JSON with source and confidence for 160 measurements, and a web viewer. It reports 415,504 triangles and a roughly 62 by 60 metre shell. The author distinguishes photographed or measured exterior features from reconstructed interior details; the interior plan is explicitly assumed. The specific model licence file states CC BY-SA 4.0 for geometry, drawings and metadata, while photographs used as evidence have separate source terms. The GLB and drawing payloads were not downloaded or checked, and dimensional accuracy was not tested. Simulation use includes contextual site geometry or a cautious digital-twin visual layer, after a modeller verifies dimensions for the intended analysis. A caveat is that it is not a structural or evacuation-ready model, because material properties, loads and a validated interior plan are absent. It complements data-urban-periscope-limassol-heritage-building-pilot as a single heritage-building geometry source, with different location and measurement provenance.
